title: Gatebraid structured handoff (gatebraid/handoff@1)
description: The mandatory structured trailer of every gate-completion / checkpoint comment on a Slice issue — the report-10 structured metadata shape (changed_files, verification with owners, residual_risk) plus decisions. Verification must show evidence, not assertion (verification-before-completion, ADR-0009/Superpowers port). A fresh session resumes from this comment plus fields, evidence, and Git state alone (ADR-0001).

workflow_to.description: The Workflow option this handoff transitions the Slice into (must be a legal transition per the spec §1).

changed_files.description: Repo-relative paths changed by the slice IMPLEMENTATION since the last handoff. A gate writes its own evidence file as part of exiting; that file is the record of the work, not the work, and does not belong here.

owner.description: Who ran / is accountable for this check.

evidence_ref.description: Where the output is recorded (evidence file anchor, CI URL). Results must be evidence-backed, never asserted.

residual_risk.description: Known remaining risks, each stated concretely. Empty array = explicitly claiming none.

decisions.description: Decisions taken since the last handoff (including consult ACCEPT/PARTIAL/REJECT outcomes), each with its rationale or a link to it.
